title: Polling: back off when no TUI is attached, and refresh live runs every 2 s
lead: *Proposed.* Drafted 2026-11-11. With no TUI subscribed, the daemon reads only what its own engine needs. With a TUI attached, a live run refreshes every 2 s instead of every 1 s. The interval values are open (Q1, Q2).
findings_note: Owner 2026-11-11 (polling too frequent). The daemon's cache keeps reading every registered project every 30 s with no TUI attached; a visible live run is read every 1 s.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
*Proposed.* Evidence read on 2026-11-11:

- `intervalLocked` (`internal/cache/cache.go:162-175`) gives every project that is not visible `SlowInterval` (30 s), whether or not any TUI is attached. `SetVisible` (`:423`) is driven by TUI subscribers (`internal/daemon/daemon_test.go:1084`: "The subscriber leaves: alpha is no longer visible, so it goes to 30 s"). With none attached, all 12 projects keep being read every 30 s.
- `LiveInterval` is 1 s (`cache.go:40`). A slicer call costs about 100 ms, so a live visible run alone keeps about 10% of a core busy.
- The engine's own reads (its runs, landings) do not depend on the dashboard cache. The implementer confirms this first and records it.

Owner decisions (2026-11-11, interactive question, relay session 8d711f67):
- Q1: with no TUI attached, the cache reads nothing on a timer; a TUI that attaches triggers a full refresh of the projects it shows (adj 301, `poll.idle-backoff` = idle-none-live-2s).
- Q2: with a TUI attached, a live run refreshes every 2 s (adj 301).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:

- `internal/cache/cache_test.go` (`TestLedgerRefreshIsOneSecondForTheVisibleProjectWhileARunIsLive` and `TestLedgerRefreshIsOneSecondForEveryVisibleProjectWithALiveRun` change with Q2)
- `internal/daemon/daemon_test.go`
- `docs/design.md`
- `CHANGELOG.md`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - With no subscriber, a fake clock advanced 10 minutes causes no read; a subscriber that attaches causes one read of each part for the projects it shows; a live visible run is read once every 2 s.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Read adj 301.
2. Confirm that the engine and the landing paths do not read the dashboard cache, and record this in the notes.
3. Change `intervalLocked` and the timer start for the no-subscriber case, and set `LiveInterval`.
4. Docs (*proposed*), and CHANGELOG.md.
